sources.instructions: Use main/ from an owned original Call of Duty installation. Its PK3 files must contain the configured multiplayer map; the public dedicated archive lacks map data.

Use main/ from an owned original Call of Duty installation. Its PK3 files must contain the configured multiplayer map; the public dedicated archive lacks map data. SteamCMD access requires the appropriate entitlement; it is not live validated.
Use the original Call of Duty main/ files (Steam app 2620), alongside the United Offensive uo/ distribution. Expansion app 2640 alone does not supply the original base content.

Use the original Call of Duty main/ files (Steam app 2620), alongside the United Offensive uo/ distribution. Expansion app 2640 alone does not supply the original base content. SteamCMD access requires the appropriate entitlement; it is not live validated.
Copy the owned Call of Duty 2 main/ data. Localization config can reside inside an IWD; use the complete original main content, not only the dedicated Linux download.

Copy the owned Call of Duty 2 main/ data. Localization config can reside inside an IWD; use the complete original main content, not only the dedicated Linux download. SteamCMD access requires the appropriate entitlement; it is not live validated.

Obtain the original 2007 Call of Duty 4, not the remaster. Copy fileSysCheck.cfg, all main/*.iwd and the full compatible zone/ fastfiles. Do not replace existing server.cfg. Managed import selects only the declared IWD/config and recognized fastfile paths. Any additional zone content requires manual staging; file checks do not prove completeness.

Obtain the original 2007 Call of Duty 4, not the remaster. Copy fileSysCheck.cfg, all main/*.iwd and the full compatible zone/ fastfiles. Do not replace existing server.cfg. SteamCMD access requires the appropriate entitlement; it is not live validated. Managed import selects only the declared IWD/config and recognized fastfile paths. Any additional zone content requires manual staging; file checks do not prove completeness.

Use an original Enemy Territory installation or the upstream FAQ-linked free game distribution. Copy pak0.pk3 to etmain/; pak1.pk3 and pak2.pk3 may be needed by third-party mods. This is separate from the ET: Legacy engine download.

In an owned Euro Truck Simulator 2 client, enable g_console, load the intended map and run export_server_packages. Supply the generated server_packages.sii and server_packages.dat from the client home. Authentication or dedicated-server downloads cannot generate these exports.

In an owned American Truck Simulator client, enable g_console, load the intended map and run export_server_packages. Supply the generated server_packages.sii and server_packages.dat from the client home. Authentication or dedicated-server downloads cannot generate these exports.

Choose a complete compatible original Action Half-Life Linux server distribution; do not substitute AHL2 or an incompatible Deleted Scenes build. Stage the complete action/ tree with maps, native libraries, models, sounds and supporting resources. Known sentinels do not prove completeness.

Obtain a complete compatible native distribution or build from upstream with game data and libraries. Current release executable naming needs verification; do not confuse a modern package with the legacy configured sentinel.

Scripts come from the owned Windows game, not a separate server app. Preserve its full Unity game data and world script. Official instructions require Steam open at runtime; this module/platform path is not validated here.

Generate/export the grid with the official ServerGridEditor and stage both JSON files plus the populated ServerGrid/ folder under ShooterGame/. Preserve the ServerOnly file as secret-bearing configuration; downloading the server does not generate this grid.

Use the original BrainBread full server distribution, not BrainBread 2. Historical mirrors may need manual retrieval. Stage the complete brainbread/ tree with maps, native libraries, models, sounds and supporting resources. Known sentinels do not prove completeness.
Supply your compatible archived complete Linux dedicated-server tree with game/mod data. No current authoritative downloadable archive has been verified.
Supply a compatible complete Linux dedicated-server archive/tree. The historical download page is not a validated direct artifact.

Generate the cluster token through Klei and create/export the matching cluster configuration. Place cluster.ini and cluster_token.txt in the configured cluster, and server.ini under the configured shard. Keep token contents private; SteamCMD cannot generate the token.

Official distribution instructions describe FoundryDedicatedServer.exe and companion Unity data. The existing module expects a native extensionless executable; that platform assumption remains unverified. Do not rename a Windows binary and claim Linux support.

Obtain a complete compatible Source 2007/AppID 310 base and official full GoldenEye: Source server distribution. Retain top-level gesource/ and sibling engine files. Existing automated URLs have documented access failures; the current official page advertises Windows content and is not a direct Linux artifact.
Use the owned complete GRAV game tree and its Binaries/ server launch scripts. The configured flat extensionless executable is a legacy module assumption, not proof of a native Linux distribution.
Obtain the official authorized Windows dedicated-server distribution or a known compatible archive; preserve all companion runtime files. No direct current artifact/access flow is verified here.
Supply a known compatible complete Identity Linux dedicated server archive/tree and Unity runtime data. Current upstream binary availability has not been verified.

Use a matching JK2MV dedicated release and owned Jedi Outcast GameData/base/assets0.pk3 and assets1.pk3. Retain assets2.pk3 for 1.03 or assets5.pk3 for 1.04 as appropriate. Match engine architecture and game version.

Obtain the server JAR and all companion libraries/mods/config from your chosen upstream project release. Place the real JAR at the configured exe_name. There is no universal custom-server download; preserve the EULA workflow.
Select the exact Technic Tekkit variant/version and use its Server Download. Preserve all bundled mods, libraries and config. A Tekkit.jar filename alone does not establish compatibility.
Use owned MOHAA main/ game data and a compatible complete Linux dedicated server/runtime tree. OpenMoHAA is a separate engine choice, not an automatic substitute.

Official instructions use the Windows mxbikes.exe -dedicated flow, dedicated.ini and full compatible package/content. The existing module native executable expectation is unverified; do not fabricate a Linux archive.

Use a complete owned Nuclear Dawn installation/server content tree; the anonymous server download is partial. A current authoritative direct artifact is not verified. Stage the complete nucleardawn/ tree with maps, native libraries, models, sounds and supporting resources. Known sentinels do not prove completeness.

Obtain a matching NS1 full install and native Linux server library. A server-only patch is not the complete content tree; do not substitute NS2. Stage the complete ns/ tree with maps, native libraries, models, sounds and supporting resources. Known sentinels do not prove completeness.

Supply a compatible complete Linux dedicated tree and q4base/ data from your owned Quake 4 installation. The previously configured public installer URL is not verified working; no replacement download is invented.
Supply a compatible original SA-MP Linux server distribution with gamemodes, scriptfiles and supporting runtime. Legacy download availability is unverified; open.mp is a separate replacement.

Select the full SourceForts Classic release compatible with the configured module, not original SourceForts or an arbitrary prerelease. Stage the complete sfclassic/ tree with maps, native libraries, models, sounds and supporting resources. Known sentinels do not prove completeness.
Obtain the complete matching official TiltedEvolution server release and config. The current documentation names Windows SkyrimTogetherServer.exe; native Linux artifact availability is unverified.
Supply owned SOF2 base/ data plus a compatible complete Linux dedicated-server binary and runtime. No current authoritative downloadable server archive is verified.

Supply a full compatible Linux x64 server build from the selected fork, including content assemblies/resources and matching client build. A fork release page is not a direct server artifact; the Wizard feed may be unavailable.
Copy a complete owned Starbound native server tree including linux64 runtime libraries and assets/packed.pak. A Windows executable alone cannot satisfy the native module.

The developer included the dedicated exe in the owned base game and discontinued the separate tool. Obtain base game app 573090 Windows with full server data. Keep provider authentication requirements; old tool 1247090 is not the current source.

Install the owned original Subnautica version required by the selected official Nitrox release and set SUBNAUTICA_INSTALLATION_PATH. Use a complete installation, not Below Zero or DLLs from arbitrary download sites. Current Nitrox supports newer game builds; do not universally force a legacy branch.

Obtain the matching The Specialists 3.0 full Linux server distribution, not only the Windows client. Stage the complete ts/ tree with maps, native libraries, models, sounds and supporting resources. Known sentinels do not prove completeness.

Supply the complete compatible Linux dedicated-server distribution with Engine/, UTGame/, libraries and applicable patch/content. Owned Windows Steam files are not the native Linux server; no current immutable Linux archive is verified.

Obtain the matching Chapter VI Linux server distribution; original mirror availability is unverified. Stage the complete vs/ tree with maps, native libraries, models, sounds and supporting resources. Known sentinels do not prove completeness.

Obtain the official compatible complete Linux release. Source SDK scaffold alone does not contain the real mod. Stage the complete zombie_master_reborn/ tree with maps, native libraries, models, sounds and supporting resources. Known sentinels do not prove completeness.

content_policy: Runnable dedicated server plus fullest compatible maps/content from declared legitimate source; reusable checked-in installer required; discard staging and unrelated client binaries.
